goal: Bind requirements-planning JSON Schema output to an explicit bounded token budget and prove the request contract through ordered same-route differential probes.
acceptance_criteria: Structured Provider requests carry messages, response_format, max_tokens, and qualified Qwen enable_thinking=false simultaneously.
The existing preflight orders plain text, JSON text, minimal JSON Schema, and real planning at 512 tokens before formal planning.
Formal planning uses a deterministic explicit output budget between 1200 and 4096 tokens with at most one bounded expansion for finish_reason=length.
Schema and request sizes and hashes, timing, budget, response-format type, and reasoning controls are recorded without secrets or full prompts.
Pre-header retries remain capped at two, response-header HTTP retries remain capped at three, and retry identity is stable.
No SourceIdentity, External Executor, generation route, agent, scheduler, executor type, lifecycle stage, or authority is changed.

prevention: Build probes through the same production payload builder and keep schema/output budget independent
assurance: Test schema short-circuit, Qwen reasoning control, retry identity, output truncation classification, and non-Qwen compatibility
control: Run deterministic scoped regressions before DashScope probes, then continue E2E only if the ordered preflight passes
improvement: Replace the prior JSON-text-only diagnostic with a real JSON Schema baseline and explicit real-512 discriminator

interface_expectations: requirements planning remains on provider_text and the reviewed canonical schema/admission route
preflight remains one support-only NOT_EVALUATED checkpoint
local_packager remains the only delivery exit
raw goal and context are not trimmed or rewritten

feedback: All four ordered live probes passed on DashScope qwen3.8-max with TLS verification and thinking disabled.
The real 512-token request returned finish_reason=length; formal 2048 also exhausted its budget, and the single 4096 expansion returned finish_reason=stop and an admitted PlanningProposal.
Canonical semantic grounding remained NEEDS_REWORK after bounded replans, so External Discovery and later stages were not evaluated.

worked: Separating JSON Schema from token budget identified the prior XOR contract defect and converted the real planning transport from pre-header timeout to a complete structured response.
did_not_work: The admitted proposals still failed existing grounding coverage, which is outside this iteration's transport scope.
experiments: Keep the ordered structured preflight and bounded 2048-to-4096 expansion; address semantic grounding only in a separately scoped iteration.
